parameters.s_blend: settle frame j = blend(S exemplar, variant j, w = smoothstep((j + 1) / k_d))
parameters.d_blend: variant frame k = blend(variant k, D', w = smoothstep((k - k_a + 1) / (N - k_a + 1)))
parameters.placement: root placed so the L_Hand/R_Hand midpoint follows the blend of the two midpoints
parameters.transform: sketch.hand_anchor_transform(S exemplar, D exemplar): yaw about z + XY on the root
parameters.windows: S's window ends before the first settle/departure frame touching with an unlabelled zone, D's starts after the last such frame of its blend (rigid_body_contacts; card: departure/arrival)
parameters.contract: per blend part against its own endpoints (settle: S exemplar + variant frame 0, braces of S; hold at D: D exemplar + variant last frame, braces of D); box, floor, new overlaps
parameters.acc_rule: per body, a junction's window may not exceed max(two sources' hold-window maxima) + acc_margin; gated twice: card = S's and D's hold windows in their clips on every junction; parts = S, the variant's settle and hold at D, D, per junction (maxima over interior stencils)

name_note: t6px is a prefix of t6px12 and t6rpx of t6rpx12, so a synthetic stem can be a substring of another clip's name (name_collisions): every per-stem filter downstream (R3's --drop, any drop list) must match stems exactly, never by substring. The runtime's motion filters match by substring (contact_graph_control: support_exclude_motions, physics_exclude_motions; hold_curriculum_evaluator: report_exclude_motions, drag_report_motions), so a pattern naming a shorter stem there also selects the longer one and its _x3s/_x7s
transition_contacts_note: zones touching the floor (rigid_body_contacts) on transition frames that no phase of the edge, nor S or D, puts on the floor: the variant's own content (admission's free_violations), recorded, not edited

dropped.E4: fails statics (as on MuJoCo); the executed head-lift is dynamic

decision.note: E2 and E5 end in a low chaturanga, 0.07-0.09 m (6-body) from the exemplar; accepted by the user

t6_decision.note: after card T6: 1) the planted-hand drift is read at 1.0 cm (the press's palms rock 0.7-1.3 cm transiently); 2) the palms' end offset is the exemplars' own 12 deg of yaw, read 'attainable': the policy learns around it; 3) the landings' slide is accepted (drift and end seams advisory on B1, E2, E5): the question is whether the policy can pick up the dynamic edges at all

d1_policy.note: seams and physx_reset apply to records that carry them (T6 on); the end seam read 'attainable' passes planted bodies whose offset to D's exemplar is the exemplars' own (seams.py); seams_drift_cm re-reads the recorded drift (the card's gate is 0.5 cm); landing_slide 'accept' keeps only the start seam hard on a landing edge (one that makes a support), its drift and end seams advisory

lineage_format.stems: [S stem, D stem, variant name]; source indexes it
lineage_format.source/source_frame: per frame: the frame's source and its frame there (variant frames for settle, transition and hold at D)
lineage_format.segment: index into seg_* (lead_in, s_exemplar, settle, transition, d_hold, lead_out)
lineage_format.blend_w/blend_source/blend_source_frame: on blend frames: the real exemplar's weight and frame (S's exemplar on the settle, D's on the hold at D); 0/-1 elsewhere
lineage_format.yaw/xy: per frame: the transform placing the frame's real source (or blend partner) in the clip: rotate by yaw about z, then shift by xy (root only; dof_pos unchanged)
lineage_format.variant_t: t on the variant's clock (NaN on real frames)
lineage_format.depenetrated: per frame: edited by the de-penetration solve (blend frames only; <stem>.json: how much)
